name: @saasreport/sim
description: Pure, seeded, replayable simulation engines: yield curves (NSS fit, par-to-zero bootstrap, bump-and-reprice duration, convexity, DV01, key-rate durations), a bond/loan/sukuk-cashflow pricer and the Basel IRRBB shock set. Every formula is implemented from the published standard, validated against its worked examples and refuses inputs outside its validated ranges.
